g.title: about.tsx becomes /about and blog/[slug].tsx a dynamic route. Files starting with an underscore are skipped.
A build plugin generates a page map of literal imports, so Bun.build code-splits every page into its own lazily loaded chunk.
Reads the embedded props, loads only the matched page chunk and hydrates, so React attaches handlers to the server HTML instead of re-rendering it.
Bun.Glob scans the pages folder at startup, normalises path separators, and compiles each pattern to a regular expression with named capture groups for params. Only the literal parts are escaped.
Awaited per request with params and pathname. A throwing data function renders a 500 page instead of crashing the server; an unmatched path renders the 404 page.
react-dom/server renders HTML. Props are embedded as JSON with the less-than sign escaped, so serialised data can never close the script tag. About 1 ms to first byte for a static page.
